correctness.rationale: For each fixed richness, collision counts have sharp integer-convexity bounds. For all sample sizes n=2,...,6, adjacent richness ranges do not overlap in the wrong direction, so a pointwise monotone-pair inequality and the independent-copy identity prove nonnegative covariance under arbitrary joint laws. For n>=7, two exchangeably permuted 3-label count profiles have opposite ordering of richness and diversity, producing a strictly negative exact covariance, with even/odd gaps proved algebraically. On two labels the result is distribution-free. An explicit 3-label de Finetti mixture yields the exact negative sample-22 rational, independently reproduced by finite multinomial summation, and an analytic -63/800 limit by bounded convergence. The standalone Python3 checker passes 313 exact assertions and does not substitute finite checks for the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Published iid positive covariance assumes a fixed categorical parent law; it neither implies a universal arbitrary-law threshold n<=6 nor rules out exchangeable n>=7 negative examples. Relevant primary texts on iid occupancy, Gibbs exchangeable partitions, and diversity indices were read to the material extent documented. Semantic searches for exchangeable and de Finetti versions did not find an implication-equivalent exact boundary. Basic deterministic bounds are mathematical tools, not claimed as original. Historical implicit coverage remains a recorded risk.
residual_risks: An unlocated older ecology, exchangeability, or sampling-without-replacement source may give an equivalent inequality or counterexample under other notation.

This review is not independent verification or a certification of publication priority.

value.rationale: Sample richness and unbiased pair Gini–Simpson diversity are natural ecological and occupancy statistics. The exact n=6/n=7 and 2/3-label sharp robustness transition answers whether the classical positive-covariance phenomenon persists under finite exchangeability, a fundamentally different sampling assumption; the explicit infinitely exchangeable 3-label counterexample shows the failure is not an artifact of finite nonextendibility, with nonzero limiting covariance. These are structural sharp boundary statements, not an arbitrary low-dimensional table or merely the known iid identity.
